title: Daggerheart Loot lists file, version 1
description: Account lists as one JSON file: the site imports it as new lists and writes it on export. llms.txt, section "Lists as a file (import-v1)", describes it for AI assistants. Frozen: a later version is import-v2.json beside this one.

$schema.title: Schema
$schema.description: The URL of this schema, for editors. Ignored on import.

format.title: Format
format.description: Names the file as a lists file.

version.title: Version
version.description: The format version this schema describes.

exported_at.title: Exported at
exported_at.description: When the site wrote the file. Ignored on import.

lists.title: Lists
lists.description: The lists, each imported as a new account list, in this order.

name.title: Name
name.description: The list's name, in Unicode code points.

money_mode.title: Money mode
money_mode.description: How the list shows prices: in bags or in coins. See "Money" in llms.txt.

player_note.title: Player note
player_note.description: The list's note that players may read through a share link.

gm_note.title: GM note
gm_note.description: The list's note that only the GM reads.

entries.title: Entries
entries.description: The list's entries in list order; an empty array for an empty list.

id.title: Record id
id.description: A record id from catalog.csv; an id the site does not know is skipped on import.

name.title: Record name
name.description: The record's name, for a person reading the file. Ignored on import.

source.title: Source
source.description: Where the record comes from; version 1 knows only the site's own data.

quantity.title: Quantity
quantity.description: How many of the record the list holds.

price_coins.title: Price in coins
price_coins.description: The price in whole coins, whatever the money mode; leave the key out for no price. See "Money" in llms.txt.

player_note.title: Player note
player_note.description: The entry's note that players may read through a share link.

gm_note.title: GM note
gm_note.description: The entry's note that only the GM reads.

lists.name: Лавка кузнеца
lists.gm_note: Кузнец торгуется, если назвать имя его брата.
